questionEn: Which formulation more accurately distinguishes “condensation” from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formula "kondensatsiya" ni o'xshash g'oyalardan aniqroq ajratib turadi?
choicesEn: process of transition of vapor into liquid state
the process of water changing from liquid to solid (ice)
process of transition from solid (ice) to liquid state
the process of changing from a liquid or solid state to a vapor state (water from ice to steam)
choicesUz: suvning suyuqlikdan qattiq holatga (muz) o'tish jarayoni
qattiq (muz) holatidan suyuq holatga o'tish jarayoni
suyuq yoki qattiq holatdan bug 'holatiga o'tish jarayoni (suv muzdan bug'ga)
explanationEn: Condensation is the process of transition of steam into a liquid state.
explanationUz: Kondensatsiya - bug'ning suyuq holatga o'tish jarayoni.
